plan.prompt: Create a single release-readiness report for the billing service that summarizes key health metrics (error rate, p99 latency, open bug count), a table of blocking issues with severity, and a go-live timeline with milestones. It is one consolidated status artifact, not code changes.

nodes.title: Billing service release-readiness report
nodes.summary: Single consolidated status artifact (not code). Includes: (1) Key Health Metrics section — error rate, p99 latency, open bug count with monitoring notes; (2) Blocking Issues table — issue id/description, severity (SEV1-SEV5), impact summary, actions; (3) Go-Live Timeline with milestones (requirements, design/config, data migration, testing/training, pre-go-live sign-off, go-live, post-go-live support); plus a closing summary. Web hints are unverified and should be treated as placeholder structure to be filled with real metrics.

assumptions.text: This node is a standalone documentation artifact with no executable code; the touch-set contains exactly one Markdown file and no signatures, schema, or config keys.
The health metrics, blocking issues, and timeline values are placeholder structure derived from unverified web hints and must be replaced with real telemetry before the report is authoritative.
No code consumers reference this document (empty call-graph impact), so the change cannot break a build or runtime path.

analysis.text: Placeholder metrics (error rate, p99 latency, open bug count) may be mistaken for verified data and used to justify a go-live decision, leading to an unsafe release.
resolution_confidence is 0 and web hints are unverified; the document may be incomplete or structurally diverge from the team's real readiness criteria.
As a static artifact, the Key Health Metrics and Blocking Issues sections go stale immediately after authoring with no automated refresh path.

benefits.text: Consolidates error rate, latency, open bugs, blocking issues, and the go-live timeline into a single reviewable artifact for release sign-off.
Provides an explicit SEV1-SEV5 blocking-issues table that forces severity and action tracking before go-live.
Docs-only change with empty call-graph impact, so it carries no runtime or build risk to the billing service.

notable_symbols.why_notable: The sole top-level section in the touch-set; defines the structure (health metrics, blocking issues table, go-live timeline) reviewers must fill with real data before release.
